reviews.author: Miguel

reviews.title: So far, so good!
reviews.comment:
The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/C1LAcE985-L.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/71B42zSdW6L._SY256.jpg I've had this for a month now, and it's been good so far! Not sure if these are good numbers, but idle temps are 45°-50° and 55°-65° while gaming. I mostly play RPGs and on high or ultra graphics (if that matters, I'm no expert), and I’ve never seen it hit 70° or higher. I did switch out the fans for Lian Li uni fans to match the rest of my pc!
The software does seem a bit dated but not difficult to learn & get the hang of. It personally doesn’t bother me the way it does other reviewers, and I’ve had zero issues with the display. It’s beautiful, and I love how big the screen!
reviews.author: Sofia

reviews.title: Just as good and cheaper then similar aios
reviews.comment: It’s nice and quiet if you use your mother boards quiet mode. Seems to keep the cpu plenty cool. Looks really good and cheaper than other aios that have a similar look. Quality seems nice. Still getting used to the software though, but changing the graphic on the aio is pretty straightforward.
